---
title: "Multi-panel by location"
description: "One panel per location with scatter and density layers."
date: 2026-01-07
categories: [subplots]
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-multi-panel-by-location
#| fig-alt: "One panel per location"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import soundscapy as sspy

data = sspy.isd.load_demo()

places = ["CamdenTown", "PancrasLock", "RegentsParkJapan", "RegentsParkFields"]

sspy.create_iso_subplots(
    data[data["LocationID"].isin(places)],
    title="Soundscapes across locations",
    subplot_by="LocationID",
    nrows=1,
    ncols=4,
    plot_layers=["scatter", "simple_density"],
)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
